oligos.notes: KD 28 nM to FV and 0.99 +/- 6.80 nM to FVa by nitrocellulose filter binding; SPR KD 11.4 +/- 3.0 nM (FV) and 4.73 +/- 0.69 nM (FVa); binds FVa light chain KD 3.33 +/- 0.69 nM vs heavy chain 113 +/- 43 nM. extraction_notes:
BUNDLE: aptamers-panel. Six sources (S21, S22, S23, S24, S25, S28), all on-target anticoagulant pharmacology - every
compound here is DESIGNED to prolong clotting, so on_target_effect is true on essentially every row and
unintended_toxicity is false throughout. No source in this bundle reports an unintended coagulopathy. That is itself the
finding: this bundle supplies the on-target dose-response and species-sensitivity backbone against which the
PS-ASO / gapmer bundles' unintended aPTT prolongation must be read.

--- CENSORING (the single biggest correctness hazard in this bundle) ---
Nine measurement rows carry values that are RIGHT-CENSORED at an instrument or assay ceiling. Every one of them stores
the ceiling with an explicit '>' and the words RIGHT-CENSORED inside readout_value, never as a bare number:
  * S23 HD1-12dmA-DAB, PT and aPTT at 500 nM: both '>999 s' (analyser maximum).
  * S23 HD1-12dmA-DAB, whole-blood ACT at 1 uM: '>999 s'.
  * S23 HD1-12dmA-DAB, ECMO-circuit ACT at 2 uM: '>999 s' at the start of circulation.
  * S23 HD1-12dmA-DAB, TEG R-time at 1 uM: '>180 min' (the assay's own maximum run length).
  * S23 HD1-12A-DAB, fibrinogen-cleavage t50 at 5 nM: '>120 min'.
  * S24 HD22-7A-DAB, TT at 31 nM: '>999 s'; and whole-blood ACT at 2 uM: '>999 s'.
  * S24 HD22-7A-DAB, fibrinogen turbidity at 50 nM: no absorbance rise over the 120-min assay.
  * S21 T18.3 + enoxaparin 500 nM / 500 IU/mL: 'aPTT exceeded 1,000 s'.
Encoding any of these as an exact value would systematically understate potency and would corrupt any dose-response fit.

A SECOND, SUBTLER CENSORING HAZARD in S23: within one figure (Fig. 4c) the same '>999 s' ACT means two opposite things.
For HD1-12dmA-DAB it is drug effect and is reversed to normal within 3 min by antidote. For the bivalirudin comparator
at >=60 min it is CONSUMPTIVE COAGULOPATHY - the source states the blood's coagulation potential is exhausted because
large thrombi have consumed prothrombin. Pooling these two censored ACTs as equivalent 'potency' would be a serious
scientific error. The bivalirudin arm is a small molecule and so has no oligo row; the hazard is documented in the notes
of the S23 ECMO ACT row.

--- ABSENCE ROWS (26 rows with effect_direction 'no_change') ---
These are measured nulls, not silence, and several are the scientific point of their source:
  * S28 rabbit plasma: aPTT unchanged at 4 uM DTRI-177, with a published mechanism - the three human factor IX contact
    residues Lys132/Leu162/Arg233 are Asn/Phe/Trp in rabbit, while the same residues are conserved across all 101 known
    mammalian factor IX sequences. Backed by a reconstitution control (hemophilia B plasma + 10% rabbit plasma).
  * S25 ROTEM EXTEM CT 57 s -> 56 s in the same animals at the same time point at which INTEM CT rises 160 s -> 380 s.
    The internal contrast is what makes the effect attributable to factor IXa rather than to global anticoagulation.
  * S21 Mut1 across five separate experiments including real COVID-19 patient plasma, and the SEL2 unselected library
    up to 1.5 uM - together these control for non-specific polyanion effects of the oligonucleotide backbone.
  * S24 HD22 alone: no effect on TT, PT or aPTT despite 0.5 nM target affinity - high-affinity binding without
    functional inhibition, a direct caution against inferring anticoagulant activity from binding data.
  * S22 cholesterol-modified AYA1809004: conjugation abolished activity on all three readouts, while the same
    conjugation on AYA1809002 did not.
  * S23 ECMO biomarkers: fibrinogen, D-dimer, TAT and prothrombin F1+2 all maintained as effectively as UFH - potent
    anticoagulation without consumptive coagulopathy.

--- MIXTURE-VS-CONJUGATE DECOMPOSITION (S23 and S24) ---
Seven rows isolate how much of the clotting-time change is attributable to the oligonucleotide as opposed to the
conjugated small molecule, by running the unconjugated equimolar mixture at matched concentrations. Result: on thrombin
inhibition, TT, PT, aPTT, ACT and TEG the mixture behaves like the small molecule alone, so the entire gain comes from
covalent linkage. The one exception is recorded too - on thrombin-mediated FVIII cleavage (S24 Fig. 3c-e) the mixture
MATCHES the conjugate, because HD22's exosite-II binding alone already blocks that particular thrombin function. The
advantage of conjugation is therefore substrate-specific, not universal. The null-arm controls (HD23-7A-DAB with a
binding-dead aptamer; HD22-7A-NH2 and HD1-12dmA-NH2 with the small molecule replaced by an inert amine) complete the
decomposition from both directions.

--- 'no_change' HAS TWO MEANINGS IN THIS FILE, ALWAYS DISAMBIGUATED IN NOTES ---
Most 'no_change' rows are true nulls (no anticoagulant effect). But four rows use it to mean 'no change relative to a
comparator that itself has an effect': S22's 24-h stability rows (effect undiminished over time), S21's T18 truncation
row (activity retained after truncation), S25's fibrinogen/platelet/FIBTEM rows (no difference from the heparin arm),
and S23's ECMO biomarker rows (levels maintained as well as with UFH). Each such row says so explicitly in its notes.
Do not aggregate 'no_change' as 'inactive' without reading the notes field.
refused_rows:
Extractable-looking material deliberately NOT written as rows, and why:

1. EVERY VALUE THAT EXISTS ONLY IN A PLOT, GEL, MICROGRAPH OR PHOTOGRAPH. Not one number was read off an image. The
   largest single loss is S21 Figure 2D (whole-blood ACT for T18.3, Mut1 and heparin across four donors and ten
   concentrations) - the text never states a single ACT value, so no S21 ACT number exists in this file at all. Also
   lost this way: S22 Figures 3, 6, 7 and 8 (the entire nine-aptamer activity panel, the 1-4 uM whole-blood dose
   response, the 24-h stability series and the antidote titration); S23 Figure 2a-d and 4c-m; S24 Figures 1c, 2d-k,
   3a-e and 4a-d; S25 Figures 2, 5, 6 and S4; S28 Figure 3G (the eight-species aPTT concentration-response, which is
   the very panel this source is prized for).

2. S21 SUPPLEMENTARY TABLES S1-S4. Unavailable: the file on disk named supp_PMC8808741.zip is an EMBL-EBI HTTP 500
   error page, not an archive. Table S4 in particular holds the eight per-patient COVID-19 baseline aPTTs and anti-Xa
   levels; only the ranges quoted in the running text (27.2-41.0 s; 0.09-0.49 U/mL) could be captured.

3. S21's FAILED OLIGONUCLEOTIDE ANTIDOTES. The source reports that several 18-nt complementary oligonucleotides could
   not completely reverse T18.3's effect, but marks it '(data not shown)'. A negative result with no data behind it is
   not a measurement; it is recorded in the notes of the protamine reversal row instead of as its own row.

4. S22's PBMC CYTOKINE PANEL AND AMES TEST. Thirteen cytokines at 1, 5 and 10 uM in PBMCs from four donors, and six
   bacterial strains at 0.5-10 uM. Both are genuine oligonucleotide safety findings and both are negative, but neither
   is a coagulation readout, so neither belongs to this endpoint. Flagged here so the immunostimulation dossier can
   pick them up: they would pair with this bundle's coagulation rows to link a coagulation and an innate-immune
   phenotype for one oligo set (S22 Figures 10-12).

5. S23's ECMO PLATELET-ACTIVATION AND INFLAMMATION MARKERS (sCD40L, p-selectin, IL-6, IL-8) and its HEMOLYSIS
   measurements. Measured in the same panel as the coagulation biomarkers that ARE encoded, but they are platelet-
   activation, inflammation and haemolysis endpoints, not coagulation-cascade readouts.

6. S25's WHITE BLOOD CELL COUNTS and blood-gas / PaCO2 data. Out of endpoint. Noted only because the source itself
   dismisses the one statistically significant WBC difference as clinically insignificant.

7. ALL COMPARATOR ROWS FOR NON-OLIGONUCLEOTIDE DRUGS. Dabigatran, bivalirudin, unfractionated heparin, enoxaparin and
   the UFH-antithrombin complex are extensively quantified in these sources (for example TT 518 s for dabigatran at
   250 nM in S24; ACT 569 +/- 107 s for UFH in the S23 ECMO circuit; time-to-occlusion 8.4 +/- 2.4 min for bivalirudin
   in S23's mouse model; mean MAX-ACT 194 s for heparin in S25). None is an oligonucleotide, so none gets an oligos
   entry or its own measurement row. Every such value is instead carried in control_value / control_description /
   effect_vs_control on the matched oligonucleotide row, so no comparator number is lost, but a query that counts rows
   by compound will correctly return zero for these drugs.

8. BINDING AFFINITIES (KD, kon, koff) AS MEASUREMENT ROWS. Dozens are reported across all six sources. They are
   target-engagement, not coagulation phenotype, so they live in the oligos[].notes field rather than as measurement
   rows. Enzyme-inhibition IC50s ARE encoded as measurement rows under readout_category factor_activity, because they
   are functional protease-activity measurements; the boundary is drawn at binding versus function.

9. S22 SECTION 3.9, CLOT-BOUND THROMBIN INHIBITION for AYA1809002 and AYA1809004. Described only as
   'concentration-dependent' with AYA1809002 higher than AYA1809004 and both 'comparable to dabigatran'; every number
   is in Figure 9. A qualitative row was considered but the readout is a fluorogenic substrate-cleavage assay on
   washed clots rather than a clotting time or factor activity, and the source gives neither value nor concentration,
   so it was left out. The equivalent S23 experiment IS encoded, because there the source states 65% versus 25% in
   text.

10. S28's IN-TEXT CLAIM THAT THE PIG RESPONSE IS 'more prominently prolonged'. Recorded as a qualitative row, but
    deliberately WITHOUT a fold-change value, because the source itself attributes the larger apparent effect to a
    lower porcine baseline rather than to greater potency. Assigning a number here would manufacture a species-
    sensitivity ranking the source explicitly disclaims.

11. NO SEVERITY GRADES ANYWHERE. severity_stated_by_source carries the source's own words verbatim or NOT_REPORTED.
    Where a source made no severity statement - which is most rows in this bundle, since these are intended
    pharmacological effects rather than adverse events - the field is NOT_REPORTED rather than an invented grade.
